units: Snh. 7ᵃ אדייה לגְּזִיזֵיה וכ׳ lifted up his club and stood (against me; Rashi: his fist).
B. Kam. 5ᵃ תבריה ר״ע לגזיזיה R. Akiba has broken the force of his club (Rashi: fist), i.e. modified his opinion; ib. 42ᵇ

<cite ref="Targum of I Chronicles 11:22">Targ. I Chr. XI, 22</cite> <he>תבר ג׳ דב׳ וכ׳</he> he cut a hole in the ice and bathed; <cite ref="Berakhot 18b:2">Ber. 18ᵇ</cite> <he>גְּזִיזֵי</he>.—Pl. <he>גְּזִיזֵי</he>.

<cite ref="Berakhot 59a:7">Ib. 59ᵃ</cite> <he>גְּזִיזַיָּיה דברדא</he> Ar. (ed. <he>גזיזי דברזא</he>) hail-stones (Ms. M. <he>בְּזִיזַיָּה דנורא</he> or <he>בְּזָאַיָּה</he>, Ms. F. <he>גְּזִירֵי</he>, v. Rabb. D. S. a. l. note).
